body.p: The Examiner is thanked for indicating that claims 10-11, 15 and 19 would be allowable if rewritten in independent form including all the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims.
Claims 1-5, 8-9, 13-14 and 17-18 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Pijls (US 2007/0078352), in view of 'T Hooft (US 2014/0194757).
Claims 6-7 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Pijls in view of 'T Hooft as applied to claim 2 above, and in further view of Van Der Mark (US 2015/0335231).
Claims 12, 16 and 20 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over

Pijls in view of 'T Hooft as applied to claim 1 above, and in further view of Yang ("Determination of the precision error of the pulmonary artery thermodilution catheter using an in vitro continuous flow rest rig").

Claims 1-5, 8-9, 13-14 and 17-18 were rejected on the ground of nonstatutory double patenting as being unpatentable over claims 1, 6, 9 and 10 of U.S. Patent No. 11,564,584., in view of Pijls and 'T Hooft.
Claims 6-7 were rejected on the ground of nonstatutory double patenting as being
unpatentable over claims 1 and 6 of U.S. Patent No. 11,564,584, in view of Pijls, 'T Hooft and Van Der Mark.
Claims 12, 16 and 20 were rejected on the ground of nonstatutory double patenting as being unpatentable over claims 1 and 6 of U.S. Patent No. 11,564,584, in view of Pijls, 'T Hooft and Yang.

As noted above, claim 1 has been amended to include the limitations of claim 10. Claim 13 has been amended to include the limitations of claim 15. Claim 17 has been amended to include the limitations of claim 19. In light of the indication in the Office Action that claims 10, 15, and 19 are directed to allowable subject matter, Applicants respectfully submit that the claims are in condition for allowance and that the § 103 and double patenting rejections are no longer relevant.
Applicants submit that the claims distinguish patentably and non-obviously over the prior art of record and are in condition for allowance. An early indication of allowability is earnestly solicited.
If any extensions of time are necessary in connection this Amendment, Applicants hereby petition for such extension.
If any fees are due in connection with this Amendment, the authorization to charge deposit account 14-1270 for the fees associated therewith is hereby provided.
Respectfully submitted, /Thomas M. Lundin/Thomas M. LundinReg. No. 48,979Philips Intellectual Property and Standards595 Miner RoadCleveland, Ohio 44143T: 440-869-4501
